notes.title: Antihero 1.0.23 - NEW MAP; RUSSIAN & JAPANESE SUPPORT
notes.content:
This update brings a new multiplayer/skirmish map, Russian and Japanese language support, and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/04e18bd20ea22395e3204d6c45ecd30d2481fabd.jpg[/img]

"The Wharf" was the very first multiplayer map I built, and it's probably the most divisive one in the game. It's smaller than average and requires 5 victory points instead of 6, and I've received complaints that it doesn't feel strategically rich enough. And I've been frustrated to see The Wharf not live up to its potential, because I like the theme and central gimmick.

So! The Duelling Docks is a new map, and an improvement on the Wharf's formula. This time around there are [i]two[/i] ships to duel over, as befits the map's name. The map is larger and has more twisty geography, and also quite a bit more stinky fish strewn about.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/0daf7f2ff8169b374303fb3d9f430983ab579654.jpg[/img]

Antihero has also gotten Russian and Japanese language support! A  Chinese translation is in QA right now and should be appearing very soon.

[b]CHANGES[/b]:
[list]
[*] New map, "The Duelling Docks"! 
[*] Fight for control of two steamships, and heaps of stinky fish.
[*] Japanese and Russian language support
[*] Text rendering improvements
[*] Various tweaks and fixes
[/list]

We welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Discord server, the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

Japanese and Russian language support

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.20 - March 2018 - THE POWDER HOUSE UPDATE
notes.content:
Fans of saboteurs and traps rejoice: your favorite explosives expert just got some new tricks!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/bbacc72b1fff34fadd6bd6936a181e14248a6c39.jpg[/img]

The "Powder House" is a new infiltratable building that can appear on all multiplayer and AI skirmish maps. A level 1 Powder House will give you a discount to Saboteur recruitment, similar to the Orphanage and Strangefellows Lodge. At level 2, the Powder House upgrades the Saboteur's traps, causing them to steal a Lantern, rather than a Coin, from any opponent unlucky enough to stumble into one.

Additionally, each multiplayer map's building distribution has been changed - when a Powder House appears on a map, it takes the slot of a building that otherwise would've been there. You can no longer count on a fixed set of buildings appearing on a given map, which shakes things up further.

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*](New) "The Powder House" building type
[*](New) Changed building distribution on all multiplayer/skirmish maps
[*](UI) The "Attack?" action prompt now shows a skull icon when the attack will kill the target, and a sword icon when it will wound them.
[*](Fix) Display the proper bribe number in the "Bribe Acquired!" animation
[*](Fix) Fix a rare "Misfortune!" error that could occur when closing the Live Match dialog.
[/list]

We welcome your comments and criticisms! You can reach us at bugs@antihero-game.com, on the Antihero Discord channel (https://discord.gg/DAKWppS) , and anywhere else fine thieving simulators are sold.

Also happy to share that we're on sale for the next week to celebrate the new update! Enjoy and happy thieving!

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.16 - player feedback!
notes.content:
Hello Antiheroes,

I've just posted the latest build, 1.0.16. (The jump from 1.0.8 to .16 is due to lots of annoying, boring, behind-the-scenes work to get the iOS and Android versions out the door.)

This patch brings several improvements from the mobile build, and addresses some player feedback and requests. Behold!

[B]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*]DLC purchased on one platform can be used on another
[*](Fix) Remember camera zoom level between turns
[*](Fix) Autosave when game is backgrounded
[*](Fix) Fix crash in Online menu for players with absurd numbers of Casual Games
[*](UI) "Fast-forward" button can be used to skip any animation (not just turn intro and outro)
[*](UI) two rows of hearts for high-health characters
[*](UI) Remember username in Login dialog
[*](Windows, Mac) improved load times
[*](Fix) Updated some German translations (thanks, xmanu!)
[/list]

We welcome your comments and criticisms! You can reach us at bugs@antihero-game.com, on the Antihero Discord channel, and by shouting "Lightfinger" into the night sky.

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

notes.title: A new map, balance changes, and more!
notes.content:
Fellow Antiheroes!

Next Thursday, November 2nd, we'll be releasing a major Antihero update. Here's a preview of what's in store:
[list]
  [*] [b]"The Agency"[/b], a new multiplayer map with a Bribery-related twist
  [*] [b]Art Critic[/b] is getting a buff
  [*] [b]Estates[/b] are getting a buff
  [*] Some [b]secret stuff[/b] I'm not allowed to talk about just yet
[/list]

This is our first post-launch update that adds new playable content to the game. And to be clear: "The Agency" map will be [b]free to all players[/b] - it's not attached to any DLC.

Because the patch involves balance changes which will invalidate all in-progress Casual Match and Skirmish saved games. (Campaign progress and Live Matches will be unaffected.)

Burgle early, burgle often,
Tim

notes.title: Localization and Mini Update Now Live!
notes.content:
This patch brings 6 new languages to Antihero. You can now play the game in [b]Spanish, French, Italian, German, Polish, and Brazilian Portuguese![/b]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*](Balance) "The Wharf" and "Big City" maps: additional scouted tiles near starting locations. (You're guaranteed to be able to scout your starting Trading House in a single action.)
[*](Balance) "Palace" and "Big City" maps: add henchmen near starting locations. (You'll always have a Gang attack target on turn 1.)
[*](UI) Multi-language support
[*](UI) Show number of remaining bribes in the Upgrade screen
[*](UI) Dozens of small UI improvements, tweaks, and fixes
[*](Fix-hopefully!) A handful of players have reported the game's visuals will occasionally freeze while audio continues playing. I haven't been able to reproduce this, but I've added some code that hopefully mitigates it...
[/list]

This update also includes some behind the scenes work to prepare for some future content and releases but nothing that will impact your games. 

As always, we welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

notes.title: New map, new languages, and more!
notes.content:
I've been working on localization for... too long. But it's finally done - as soon as we get the thumbs up from QA, Antihero will grow some new languages:
[list]
    [*]German
    [*]Spanish
    [*]French
    [*]Italian
    [*]Polish
    [*]Brazilian Portuguese
[/list]
(I've just learned that "crapule" is French for "scoundrel";  this is my new favorite French word.)

Localization is important but dull. Much more excitingly, a new skirmish/multiplayer map is in development. It's (tentatively) called [b]"The Agency,"[/b] and brings some new bribery-related gameplay twists. After a bit more internal playtesting, it'll be landing in Antihero (for free)!

There are several other mysterious (dangerous, even?) projects currently underway in the Antihero pipeline, including the imminent appearance of some rather unexpected individuals.

Stay devious, all you crapules!

- Tim

[/list]

As always, we welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.4 - August 3, 2017 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Antihero 1.0.4 - August 3, 2017

This patch is focused on online stability! There was a bug in The Wharf map that would occasionally cause crashes in Live Matches that's been fixed, along with a handful of other minor backend issues.

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]
[*](Balance) Masquerade - initial Henchman starting locations have been moved to make Gangs less vulnerable in the early game.
[*](Fix) Live Match - winning "The Wharf" with a Cargo victory point no longer results in an error.
[*](Fix) Fix a rare login error that could occur on slow connections.
[*](Fix) Enemy Business info panels no longer display the number of infiltrated Urchins if the Business is unscouted.
[*](UI) On super-widescreen displays, the Casual Matches list no longer overlaps the matchmaking buttons.
[*](UI) Infiltration notifications are no longer blurry.

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.3 - July 28, 2017 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Antihero 1.0.3 - July 28, 2017

This build brings BALANCE CHANGES, QUALITY-OF-LIFE improvements, and LEADERBOARD UPDATES. All in-progress casual matches and skirmishes have been reset - this is necessary when we change game rules, to prevent games from being in broken states. (But we'll do this as infrequently as possible, and always give you a heads-up beforehand.)

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*](Balance) Units can now move through their own guild house. This makes it easier to escape when an opponent tries to box you in with their thugs.
[*](Balance) Traps in Guard Towers and The Palace get removed when the Palace is burgled.
[*](Leaderboards) "Skill" leaderboards are now available for Casual and Live Match modes. The Skill leaderboards show your matchmaking rank value. We use a TrueSkill-like system for calculating player skill. Skill is not directly related to your number of wins - a player with a high number of both wins and losses may have a lower skill ranking than another player with a lower number of wins but very few losses. (The server has been calculating player skill since the game launched, so the skill values you see today account for all match history.)
[*](UI) "Transparent Buildings" hotkey. While this key is held, buildings become transparent, making it easier to see where your opponent has scouted. (You'll need to add a keybinding in the Keyboard Controls dialog.)
[*](UI) Clicking on an unscouted tile that you can't reach will show you the tiles you need to scout to get there, in grey.
[*](Fix) "-", "^", and "\" can now be typed in Live Mode chat
[*]Several other minor UI tweaks and bugfixes
[/list]
As always, we welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.2 - July 21, 2017 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Antihero 1.0.2 - July 21, 2017

This Antihero version adds a handful of features that players have been asking for in the forums. It also, of course, fixes a small handful of bugs and annoyances, and improves the servers in SECRET UNKNOWABLE WAYS. When we update the servers, we generally need to kick everyone out of their Live Matches, so if this happened to you: apologies! But it's for the greater good (and won't happen too frequently).

[h1]RELEASE NOTES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hotkeys! Antihero remains a very mouse-driven game, so hotkeys are entirely optional. But this should be helpful to players using Steam Controllers.
[*]'Mute Audio in Background' option. (This is on by default, but we had some requests to leave audio unmuted when the app is backgrounded.)
[*]Fixed a Gang animation glitch
[*]Various minor bugfixes
[/list]

As always, we welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/bda0a79677f3adca0d20eb3acea408d08f158c45.png[/img]

Thanks!
- Tim and the Antihero team

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.1 - July 13, 2017 Update
notes.content:
Antihero 1.0.1 - July 13, 2017

This patch addresses some minor bugs and irritants!

[list]
[*]You can now skip turn-ending animations with the fast-forward button
[*]Exiting a singleplayer game while your opponent is making their winning move will no longer trap you in purgatory, forcing you to watch your defeat over and over and over. Once you see the Victory or Defeat screen, your autosave will be removed.
[*]Fixed several rare "Misfortune!" errors related to app launching, saved settings, and adding turn commands while the turn is already ending
[*]It's possible there's another Secret Code out there somewhere
[/list]

Also no in-game patch notes this time so we can keep the multiplayer version the same and not mess up anything on that front. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Looking Ahead - Roadmap
notes.content:
Looking Ahead for Antihero

First off, thank you all for the amazing Launch Day! It’s great to see people enjoy the game after 4 years of development. I can’t thank you enough for sharing the game and giving us feedback.

Secondly, please know that we are listening to all that feedback! We’d like this game to live a very long and happy life, and that means ongoing maintenance, improvement, and expansion. We’ll start with a minor patch that’ll come this Thursday to address some low-hanging fruit:

[h1]This week:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]More secret codes... 
    [*]The Black Plague will begin spreading! 
    [*]Minor bug fixes (97.43% of you never saw them - for those that did, you didn’t see them either)
    [*]DLC fixes (we had some hiccups that affected a small number of players)
    [*]Ability to skip turn-end animations
[/list]

[h1]Looking forward to the near future, this is what we’ll be addressing:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]In-game manual
    [*]Rebindable hotkeys
    [*]Animation speed improvements
    [*]More maps!
    [*]A 2v2 or FFA style map for more players.
    [*]Localization
    [*]AI changes. (This’ll be ongoing - there are a few places where the AI seems to be giving people too much trouble, and a few where it doesn’t give them enough!)
[/list]

Some of these future changes will take more time than others, and our priorities may change based on other feedback and yadda yadda yadda. But this is generally the direction we’ll be proceeding in!

--Tim and his gang

notes.title: Launch Trailer and Multiplayer Modes!
notes.content:
Hello All! 

We're 3 days away from launch and we wanted to ensure everyone had a good idea of what our multiplayer matches look like and how they work - as well as share our new launch trailer! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n6ZYAlfOIRQ 

Currently all of our multiplayer maps are 1v1, and we have multiple ways for you to play.

[h1]Live Matches[/h1] 
Live Match mode is where you will be playing against another person "live" and with turn timers. This is similar to how Hearthstone and many other turn-based board game and card games work. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/5124aeef661223ab76d2e88bad44047334e09d18.png[/img]

[h1]Casual Matches[/h1]
In the game's Casual Match mode, there are no timers, you can have multiple games going at once, and your opponent doesn't have to be online at the same time. Games play out over several days, and you'll get an e-mail (and an in-game notification, if you're online) when it's your turn again.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/7ecbf70e6f96a25543e7922c36fafe8c5724a0c5.png[/img]

[h1]Hotseat[/h1]
In Hotseat mode, you play against a friend on the same computer - no internet connection required. Also, if you catch your opponent peeking at the screen during your turn, you're allowed to steal all the money in their real-life wallet.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/81202f933624c5690bd04f559367467da1d17156.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Rules[/h1]
Automatch games are ranked and have associated leaderboards. But if you're playing an invite game with a friend, you have the option to customize the game's rules. If this is popular, we'll add more rules-customization options based on community feedback!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/3f04a7068919cd6e7eb0f49ac67d28f1f1027b0e.png[/img]

We're looking forward to seeing all of you folks on Monday! 

-Antihero Gang
